hero.headline: We build your company's digital future
hero.subheadline: We turn your ideas and processes into digital systems that work, look amazing, and grow your business.

services.title: What can we build for you?
services.subtitle: No jargon, no complications. Pick what best describes what you need — we'll take care of the rest.

items.title: Online Store
items.description: Take your business online and start selling without limits. We build your complete store with a product catalog, secure payments, inventory control, and everything you need to start operating from day one.

items.title: Website & Landing Page
items.description: Your online presence, done right. We design professional websites that represent your brand, attract customers, and turn visitors into real business opportunities — 24 hours a day.
features: Professional design tailored to your brand

items.title: Custom System
items.description: Does your business need something more specific? We'll build it from scratch. Business management systems, point of sale, desktop applications — any solution that automates and organizes how your company operates.
features: Point of sale (POS) for your business

demoViewer.ctaBody: Like this design? Tell us your idea and we'll build something like this for your business.

process.title: Our Process
process.subtitle: A clear process with no surprises, where you always know what stage your project is at.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.description: You tell us what you need and what your goals are. No commitment, no cost. We just listen and understand your business.

steps.title: UX/UI Design
steps.description: We show you what your system will look like and how it will work before we start building it. You approve every detail.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: We build your system in short stages, showing you progress constantly so you're always up to date.

steps.title: QA Testing
steps.description: We test everything thoroughly before delivery: making sure it works perfectly, is easy to use, and has no errors.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.description: We deliver your system working 100% and teach you how to use it. Your employees will operate everything without a problem.

steps.title: Evolution
steps.description: We don't leave you alone. After delivery we remain available for adjustments, improvements, and any questions you have.

portfolio.title: Projects that speak for themselves
portfolio.subtitle: Real businesses that trusted us and transformed their operations.

items.title: Online Store — RetailMex
items.description: Online store with 500+ products, integration with national and international payments, real-time inventory control, and a complete admin panel.

items.title: Logistics System — LogisTech
items.description: Fleet management system with real-time tracking, driver management, automatic route reports, and an executive dashboard for decision-making.

items.title: Financial Control System
items.description: Expense and income tracking platform for businesses with automatic reports, trend analysis, and smart alerts.

about.title: A focused team building software that fits your operation
about.description: We are a team based in Hermosillo, Sonora. We build custom websites, internal tools, and online stores that stay clear, fast, and easy to maintain. We have also worked on large administrative projects: serious reporting, permissions, integrations, and day to day operations where reliability matters. We stay close to whoever makes the decisions, explain tradeoffs in plain language, and aim for software your team will actually use.

items.title: Communication you can actually follow
items.description: We share honest updates and a simple plan everyone can understand. If a date or scope looks risky, we say it early. That usually means fewer surprises and fewer weeks lost waiting on approvals.

items.title: Design that fits how you work
items.description: We design for your users and your real workflows, not a generic template. Clean layouts, consistent patterns, and a modern look that still feels practical when people use it every day.

items.title: Progress you can see, results you can feel
items.description: We work in stages with demos and checkpoints, so you are never guessing what is coming next. The goal is smoother operations, less manual work, and a system you can keep improving over time.
